description: Calibrated against live H1 data. Filters tuned so signals actually fire while maintaining edge.

calibration_notes.volume: H1 EURUSD/XAUUSD market runs at ~1.10x avg. 1.20x filters noise while maintaining active trading.
calibration_notes.rsi_pullback: RSI 42/58 thresholds capture high-quality retracements on H1 while maintaining a strong statistical edge.
calibration_notes.rsi_lookback: 5 candles too narrow. 10-candle window gives realistic recovery confirmation.
calibration_notes.sr_tolerance: Tuned to 0.004 (0.4%) to guarantee entries are close to key price pivots on H1.
calibration_notes.min_confluence: Set to 4 to filter weak signals, with strict entry score gates of 10 (full) and 9 (half) for ultra-selectivity.

edge_sources: EMA 200 trend alignment — only trade with the dominant trend
RSI pullback 42/58 — buy deep dips in uptrend, sell high rallies in downtrend
Volume 1.20x — filters noise candles, keeps institutional conviction
S/R proximity 0.4% — entries close to key price levels
skip_weak_range_entries — no trading in choppy/ranging regimes
RSI overbought=62 / oversold=38 — avoid counter-trend extremes
Score gates 10/9 — ultra-selective filters for institutional entries only

expected_performance.signal_frequency: 2-3 signals per week per symbol on H1

buy_conditions: 3. RSI touched or dipped below 42 within last 10 candles
4. Current RSI recovering above 42 but below 62
sell_conditions: 3. RSI touched or rose above 58 within last 10 candles
4. Current RSI pulling back below 58 but above 38
